ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (~10%) to low-intensity pixels (~90%) across the visible surface; high local contrast at feature boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at the distal right tip and bottom-center margin; scattered high-intensity linear filaments and point-source pixels distributed across the low-intensity (black) field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 145 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 4% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel peaks and valleys along the entire boundary; notable macro-indentations on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe and distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep along the trailing edge, tapering to rounded, upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-intensity pixel blobs at the right distal apex; high-density stippling of white pixels at the fluke-peduncle junction.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible; prominent diagonal white marks on the left lobe and smaller horizontal streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and missing tissue segments along the trailing edge; numerous white rake-mark patterns crossing the primary dark pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'stardust' pattern of high-intensity pixels localized near the inferior central vertical axis.
